key_insight: A SCAPS-1D + machine learning workflow can rapidly rank multilayer perovskite solar-cell stacks and pinpoint the most influential layer properties for high efficiency.
engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical design rule set for selecting ETL, absorber, and HTL materials, accelerating optimization of both conventional and lead-free double perovskite solar cells.
method: Trained an ML model on a representative subset to predict PCE for unseen stacks.
Used SHAP to identify the dominant descriptors driving performance.
evidence_signal: Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation showed reliable ranking performance, and full SCAPS-1D verification confirmed top predictions such as 28.85% for FTO/TiO2/Cs2AgBiBr6/NiO/Ag.
watch_item: The ML ranking depends on the quality and coverage of the simulated training set, so predictions may be less reliable for material combinations outside the explored design space.
paper_title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
